Recorded claim:
After upstream localization field changes, reconstruct the per-locale Gecko repo/revision map from l10n_revisions while preserving the separate shared comm_strings repository/revision metadata. Validate strings_all.tar.zst contents and l10n-changesets.json shape, not only job completion. The accepted review explicitly added L10n-pre and L10n-pre-S jobs and comparison with release artifacts. Current source still emits both gecko_strings and comm_strings.
